answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 90 identities means 90 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the nadir pair is tracked in the echo ledger, the bridge audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 59%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
